items.item_text: resume
references
A bachelor’s degree in business or a related field and a minimum of 10 years of demonstrated success in business development, project management, and sales are required.
A master’s degree is preferred.
An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of the position may be considered.
Experience in health or life sciences is a plus.

Relationship Management Establish and maintain strategic contacts in government and industry at pharmaceutical, biotech, health care, health IT, physical science, and medical device companies. Cultivate strong relationships with existing and potential industry partners to further the Institute's goals in Team Masters Projects (TMPs), Industry PhDs, PharmD fellowships, corporate education, and corporate sponsored research. Improve renewal rate of TMPs. Maintain contact with current TMP sponsors to monitor quality and satisfaction with the goal of renewing the following year. Build a strong team culture while providing direct supervision of CP staff. Effectively work across the Office of Research, Innovation, and Strategic Engagements (RISE) to build relationships and collaborate on strategic plans and broader goals.

New Business Development and Sponsorships Develop strategies for effective outreach and new business development. Research and attend industry networking events and conferences with the goal of increasing KGI’s network (up to 15% travel). Secure new corporate education opportunities through leveraging existing relationships or offering existing coursework to new clients. Help coordinate external sponsorship efforts for flagship events such as the Bioprocessing Symposium and the Rigg’s Research Symposium, generating increased visibility and financial support for institutional initiatives. Pursue new industry relationships with a clear strategy and specific outreach goals. Lead CP Team to identify and qualify at minimum sixty (60) Team Master’s Project (TMP) leads per academic year. Lead CP Team to secure required number of TMP contracts for the academic year based on student enrollment projections.

Advisory Board Support Support the External Advisory Boards (EAB) ensuring robust membership engagement, guidance for focused committees and leadership of the Executive Committee. Develop metrics and track the overall effectiveness of the relationships stemming from EAB membership.

Project & Event Management Lead the planning, recruiting, promoting, managing, and measuring effectiveness of events, such as External Advisory Board meetings, TMP Kick-off, PharmD fellow professional development, KGI Bioprocessing Symposium and Riggs Research Symposium. Work closely with the KGI Marketing team, Academic Affairs, Advancement, Career Services, and others in order to take a leadership role in events that may have corporate involvement. Lead regular CP team meetings to develop staff, establish goals, and increase collaboration Lead collaborative efforts across KGI to ensure coordination with Advancement, Alumni Relations, Career Services, and Academic Affairs.

Data Management Keep track of and report corporate activities in Raiser’s Edge NXT and other software services as needed. Identify areas of improvement for accuracy and efficiency. Run reports, create dashboards, and analyze data for effective decision-making. Develop annual CP budget and track monthly expenses to ensure budget compliance. Provide departmental updates and draft articles for the RISE Newsletter.
Must be experienced in relationship management, either from a fundraising, business development, sales, or marketing background.
Entrepreneurial energy, self-direction, and an eagerness to generate ideas are essential.
Excellent project management skills, ability to balance competing priorities, and complex situations.
Proficient with technology. Digitally dexterous with a high level of proficiency in Microsoft Office products (including Excel) and CRM systems.
Must have excellent professional rapport, exceptional oral and written communication skills and a strong customer service orientation.
Must be deadline-driven, highly organized and detail oriented.
Must be able to work independently, take initiative and follow-through on issues.
Must be willing to work collaboratively as a member of the Corporate Partnerships team, and to participate enthusiastically in the life of the Institute.
Experience working with a diverse campus community and possess a commitment to equity and inclusion.
Able and willing to work weekend and evening hours, as required for events and programming.
